name: Bandsintown Concerts API
tagline: Artist tour dates and concert listings for music apps and sites.
description: The Bandsintown Concerts API provides public endpoints for artist profiles, upcoming and past event listings, and related venue data. Developers use an app_id (API key) to query concert schedules by artist name or Bandsintown artist ID, making it a common integration for music discovery apps, ticketing widgets, and tour-date embeds. Access is free for approved use cases; commercial or high-volume use may require partnership.

auth.details: App ID (API key) as query parameter app_id on every request; self-serve via Bandsintown artist/support API docs (register application name as app_id).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial/approved use; rate and volume limits not publicly published as fixed quotas
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial/high-volume use via Bandsintown partnership (not self-serve public pricing)

use_cases: get upcoming concert dates for an artist by name
list past tour dates for an artist
fetch artist profile and social links from Bandsintown
resolve a Bandsintown artist ID for event queries
show venue city and ticket offer links for an artist's shows
